tasks.title: Create Animation Studio business unit and 20-worker organization
tasks.goal: Create the reusable business-unit model and the first owner-controlled animation studio with 8 teams and 20 virtual roles.

tasks.title: Build persistent Character Bible and continuity memory
tasks.goal: Lock recurring characters, relationships, appearance, voices, locations, canon facts, and episode continuity in persistent versioned memory.
tasks.result: Persistent local-only SQLite Character Bible with immutable version history, locked-field owner override, relationship graph, canon facts, episode continuity events, snapshots, and a private 16-character initial cast seed.

tasks.title: Build Story and Episode Planning Engine
tasks.goal: Turn a topic into season-aware episode briefs, screenplay, dialogue, educational/emotional beats, and approved production packets.
tasks.result: Season-aware persistent Story/Episode Planning Engine with Character Bible context injection, deterministic zero-cost fallback, strict structured-AI planner contract, cast/continuity validation, exact duration checks, versioned episode packets, and explicit owner approval/rejection state.

tasks.title: Build Scene, Shot, Prompt and Asset Graph
tasks.goal: Convert scripts into deterministic scenes/shots with character references, camera, environments, timing, continuity constraints, and asset provenance.
tasks.result: Deterministic persistent Scene/Shot/Prompt/Asset Graph with exact timing, Character Bible reference assets and provenance hashes, environment refs, renderer-ready prompt packs, continuity constraints, pending render outputs, versioned private graph storage, and strict zero-render/zero-network behavior.

tasks.title: Connect visual generation and animation pipeline
tasks.goal: Connect ComfyUI/approved compute adapters for repeatable character-consistent image/video generation with cost and approval gates.
tasks.result: Localhost-only ComfyUI adapter, deterministic render-job planner, persistent render manifest DB, API-workflow placeholder contract, health/node inventory, owner+execution dual gate, and private dry-run manifest for all STUDIO-004 shots. No render job was submitted during installation. Provider upgrade: AHOS now has a multi-provider media registry plus a guarded RunPod Serverless LTX-2 adapter using the existing endpoint. RunPod paid execution requires owner_approved + execution_enabled + paid_provider_enabled simultaneously; secrets remain environment-only. Preview render default is 1024x576 (exact 16:9; both dimensions divisible by 32).

tasks.title: Build voice, music, dubbing and localization pipeline
tasks.goal: Generate character-consistent speech, music/SFX, subtitles, and multi-language localized episode variants.
tasks.result: Live Kokoro baseline is now verified end-to-end on RunPod and wired into AHOS with guarded paid-execution gates. Persistent per-character/per-language voice continuity is implemented with owner-override protection and no silent wrong-language fallback. Versioned localization memory, review gates, and locked terminology consistency are implemented. Agent Skills for voice continuity and multilingual dubbing were hardened. Technology Radar now tracks Chatterbox Multilingual V3 as the preferred multilingual voice-cloning trial candidate for Turkish, German, Arabic, French, Spanish, and English. Remaining STUDIO-006 work: deploy/verify the multilingual provider, then add music/SFX, subtitle timing, dubbing fit, mix QA, and final multi-language audio package.

tasks.title: Build episode assembly and studio QA pipeline
tasks.goal: Assemble scenes into finished episodes and enforce continuity, child-safety, audio, subtitle, technical, and release-package QA.

tasks.title: Run one complete studio acceptance episode
tasks.goal: Run one owner-approved topic through the whole studio to a publish-ready multi-language episode package and expose progress in the Holding Control Center.
